notes.title: Rooftop Cop 1-year Birthday UPDATE
notes.notes:
Hello Hello!
I completed Rooftop Cop a year ago this month and during that time it was featured at a number of festivals and garnered some nice attention from different publications and the like. It even got two IGF nominations which I still feel funny about!
Anyway there were always a few things here and there that irked me and as much as I tried to not let it bother me it always kept nagging at me. SO! This update address those things, which weren't huge, but I feel much better about the whole project in general now which feels really good. Thanks to everyone who has taken a chance on this game and sent messages or said hi, it's not easy to find a place for something like this on Steam -- yall are the best! 

Here is a list of changes, which is more-or-less comprehensive:

MENUS

 title splash updated, loads faster
 individual games' splash screens all updated
 transitions are even more neat now

PART 1

 attempting any action is more clear, via animation
 collected citations and current deficit are separate and tallied together each time the timer runs out
 citizens now have income
 citizens may now commit more and different small "crimes", like loitering and littering
 you may now "watch" a citizen
 assigning citations, placing fences, and watching are now separate tools
 citizens sometimes don't pay citations
 bunch of graphics updates

PART 2

 unintended slowness reduced (4000+ physics objects...)
 intended slowness retained :)

PART 3

 some graphic/sound fixes and updates

PART 4

 now persistent within a session, can leave and come back
 debris more frequent and is less cruel about its distance from the raft
 birds blink less often
 individuals are generally more content

PART 5

 now persistent within a session, can leave and come back
 sticks near water are wet
